intro: Rugby is New Zealand's national sport, and the All Blacks are one of the most successful teams in any sport.

chapters.title: The All Blacks
text: The All Blacks have won the Rugby World Cup three times (1987, 2011, 2015) and perform the haka before matches. The women's Black Ferns have won six World Cups.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Sailing (the America's Cup), rowing and netball are also strong. Lisa Carrington has won eight Olympic canoe golds.

keyTerms.meaning: The men's rugby team, named for their black kit.
